files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed
- The language you watched in is shown again: as a flag on movie cards
  (lost in 1.2.0, when rewatches moved the language to each watch) and,
  new, on TV show cards; with flag and name for each entry in a movie's
  watch history and next to the language of a TV show. Screen readers get
  the language name instead of the flag.
